Well I don't know if you're going to get an answer because there's so many great answers from this session. Here's why. Think back to when we used to use Slack. We loved Slack. Why did we love Slack? Because everyone was there. It wasn't perfect. Sometimes it was too noisy. Sometimes you didn't hear things. But at least you knew that everybody was there. Now imagine you're on a team. You log in to your app. There's no one there. There's no way to ask a question.
